# City and See

> > A travel and lifestyle blog featuring destination guides, coffee shop reviews, fashion inspiration, and travel essentials across cities like Tokyo, Singapore, Jacksonville, and beyond.

City and See is Katherine's personal travel blog documenting urban explorations, neighborhood guides, cafe culture, thrifted fashion, and practical travel tips. The blog covers destinations from Tokyo's Shibuya and Shimokitazawa to Singapore's Kampong Glam, with a focus on coffee culture, sustainable fashion, and authentic local experiences.

## Key Topics

- Tokyo neighborhood guides
- Singapore travel
- Coffee shop culture
- Thrift fashion and sustainable style
- Travel packing essentials
- Kampong Glam district
- Shibuya cafes
- Jacksonville, Florida
- Roasted Laboratory Coffee
- Weekend travel planning
- Day trip guides
- Travel photography
- Outfit inspiration
- Urban exploration
- Local cafe reviews

- [Shimokitazawa day guide | Shopping, food and cafes](https://www.cityandsee.com/shimokitazawa-day-guide): Tokyo's Shimokitazawa neighborhood guide for vintage shopping and cafes
- [Guide to Singapore's Kampong Glam neighborhood](https://www.cityandsee.com/kampong-glam/guide-to-singapores-kampong-glam-neighborhood-3): Neighborhood travel guide to Singapore's Kampong Glam district
- [A Guide to The Best Coffee Shops in Jacksonville, Florida](https://www.cityandsee.com/jacksonville-coffee-shops): Jacksonville coffee shop guide covering Murray Hill, Riverside, Springfield
- [A day trip to Vejer de la Frontera](https://www.cityandsee.com/a-day-trip-to-vejer-de-la-frontera): Day trip guide to Vejer de la Frontera pueblo blanco in Andalucía, Spain
